purpose: Identity review against user supplied canonical turnaround; same branch, no merge

clips.name: light-punch
clips.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Correct an animation sprite strip for an existing original 2D fighting game character. Image 1 is the AUTHORITATIVE character turnaround: copy this exact man's mature narrow face, long angular jaw, small moustache AND pointed dark goatee, sleepy hooded eyes, angular nose, cheek lines, low tied bun and loose forelock. The rejected image 3 is ONLY an action/layout guide, NOT an identity or color reference. Image 2 is the existing idle gameplay strip for continuity of proportions and start/end gestures.
Critical corrections: do not inflate head, neck, shoulders, torso or hands while striking. Same tall very slender long-legged adult body, small head (approximately one eighth of standing height), narrow waist and fine wrists as image 1 throughout. Same face in every pose. No younger clean-shaven substitute, no muscular broad hero. Match the original turnaround's warm medium-brown skin (not pink, orange or red), dark brown hair with a very slight auburn tint (not red), soft warm ivory tailored blazer, deep muted burgundy shirt, near-black charcoal flared trousers, very dark chocolate brown polished low-heeled dress boots, gold wristwatch. Boots must stay the same deep brown in ALL poses, never bright reddish purple. Neutral consistent lighting without magenta spill, no changing skin exposure. Controlled angular ink/cel shadows and subtle texture directly matching image 1; preserve natural shading, avoid posterization and patchy recoloring.
Exactly SIX complete full-body poses of light-punch, facing RIGHT. Preserve the action order from image 3, but pose 1 must gently depart from the relaxed idle hands/stance in image 2; pose 2 anticipates; pose 3 is the full extension and contact; pose 4 retracts; pose 5 relaxes hands; pose 6 matches the original relaxed idle stance from image 2 to connect seamlessly. Light lead-hand straight jab at face height, restrained torso rotation. Do not turn the back to the viewer during recovery: small controlled torso rotation, no scale inflation or camera-facing lunge.
Extremely wide single row with clear generous blank gutters and no touching/overlap between characters. All hair, hands and boots entirely visible. Solid flat pure magenta #FF00FF background, no floor shadow, gradients or scenery. No text, numbers, weapons, effects, trails, motion blur, labels or extra characters. Same character identity and immutable material colors across the whole strip.
